steps: Welcome to Claude at work: Maya becoming an A I fluent lead. She types help me with reports, it flops with generic advice, and Maya learns the four Ds of A I fluency.
Next, her onboarding procedure stops vanishing into scrollback. It becomes an Artifact, with one stable link for the whole team.
Then the same prompt gives three different answers, so Maya adds role, context, task and format, and gets consistent output.
Next, Maya parks her three hundred word brief and glossary in a team Project. Every chat inherits the rules, and her prompts shrink to fifty words.
After two approximate totals, Code Execution runs Python in a sandbox and returns exactly forty-four thousand two hundred and eighty-seven dollars, which Maya verifies.
Then Maya spots salaries in the performance reviews, so she classifies, redacts and reviews before she prompts.
Then a three hundred percent growth statistic turns out to be invented. Maya pinpoints it, with no primary source, before it reaches the board.
Finally, Maya is her team's A I fluent lead: clear prompts, saved procedures, exact numbers, safe data and checked facts. You can work the same way.
